title: What the Green Sea Turtle remembers

is_this_you.pressure: When it gets hard, you swim out past calling distance and settle it alone. You come back with the matter closed.
is_this_you.love: You can go a season without a word and still expect the bond to be where you left it.
is_this_you.cost: Some years you stay out too long, and the shore you come back to has moved on.

opener.text: In Chinese, people who study or work abroad and then come home are called 海歸 (hǎiguī), "returned from overseas" [t12]. The word sounds the same as 海龜 (hǎiguī), sea turtle, and the pun has stuck [t12] [t13]. You were born a Cancer in a Horse year, and the language already had a name for you. You leave for the open sea. Then you come back.

howto: Three parts. Swim off between them if you need to.

tabs.label: The way home
tabs.intro: Water that calls you back, Fire that sends you out.

rows.text: Cancer is cardinal Water, ruled by the Moon, tender toward memory and protective of its people [t1] [t2]. The Horse is yang Fire, lively and honest, fond of adventure and bad at taking orders [t3] [t4]. In you the most homeward sign meets the most restless animal. You take them in order. First the open current, then a straight line back.

Green turtles often return to nest on the beach where they hatched, sometimes decades on [t8]. Studies of loggerheads suggest sea turtles find that beach by its magnetic signature, learned as hatchlings [t7]. You carry an address like that. Years go by, and you could still walk to it in the dark.

tabs.label: The lost years
tabs.intro: Gone from sight. Never gone for good.

rows.text: Young green turtles spend about three to five years in an oceanic stage, out where they are hard to follow [t5]. Scientists call that stretch the lost years [t5] [t6]. Your old friends know your version. A long silence, then you surface beside them as if no time had passed.

In open water the young turtles eat animals [t5]. Adults live almost only on seagrass, seaweed and algae [t8]. You have been two different people in one life. The ones at home still know you on sight.
Field science and foreign postings suit you. Each gives you distance and one base to guard.

tabs.label: Who you come back to
tabs.intro: Three shores that keep your shape. One that pulls the tide wrong.
tabs.love_lead: In love you need someone who reads a long silence as trust. You come back all the way, and you hope to find things as you left them. Three old Chinese pairings hold the shore for you.

easy.why: The Leopard Seal (Pisces, Tiger year) shares your fire trine of Tiger, Horse and Dog, and Pisces is Water like Cancer [t3] [t1].
The Glasswing Butterfly (Cancer, Goat year) is your secret friend, since the Goat is the Horse's hidden ally, and it shares your Moon-ruled sign [t3] [t1].
The Tasmanian Devil (Scorpio, Dog year) closes the Tiger, Horse and Dog trine from the third Water sign [t3] [t1].

hard.why: The tide runs wrong with the Marbled Polecat: the Rat clashes with the Horse, and Capricorn sits opposite Cancer [t3] [t1].

story.text: In the Japanese tale, a fisherman named Urashima Tarō saves a sea turtle, and it carries him down to the Dragon Palace under the sea [t16]. When he goes home, his parents and his village are gone, because his days below were three hundred years above [t16]. He opens the box he was told to keep shut and grows old at once [t16].

closing: Swim as far as you need to. The sand you hatched on still knows your weight.
